context.transcript:
Good morning, everyone.
I'm sorry our tour is getting off to a late start.
We have some tour group members staying at hotels on the other side of town, and they'll be arriving at any moment.
To help speed everything along, please start lining up single file so we can board the bus as soon as everyone arrives.
Oh, and someone asked what the group number on the tickets means.
You can disregard that.
It's part of an old system of ours.
context.transcript_translation:
大家早上好。
很抱歉我们的游览开始得有点晚。
我们有一些旅游团成员住在镇子的另一边酒店，他们随时都会到达。
为了加快一切进程，请排成单列等待，这样等所有人到齐后我们就可以上巴士了。
哦，有人问票上的组号是什么意思。
您可以忽略这一点。
这是我们一个旧系统的一部分。
